title: Buriska's Oscilloscope
description: A new block - Oscilloscope that measures Redstone and FE power
body:
### **Description**
This is a small mod that adds an Oscilloscope, which can measure Redstone power along with FE power. Currently, only Mekanism is supported, but more mods will be added in future versions along with new Features.
### **Additional links**
**CurseForge:** [Project page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/buriskas-oscilloscope)
